finding: The emitted-record inventory previously stopped observing common-header owner fields after the first 330, so a duplicate 330 outside an application group and before the first subclass could leave the owner query true.
change: Keep observing until the first subclass marker or record boundary. Multiple common-header owner fields make owner queries false, even for equal values. Ignore reactor/application 330s and post-subclass body references. Preserve ambiguity in record checkpoints and restore it on rollback. Retain the maximum observed owner for the conservative wide-owner guard.
